correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the rank-oriented Boolean 4-cube (16 vertices, 32 arcs) and proved the simplicial join factorization by the independent in/out constraints at each rank. Enumerated the 12-edge rank-one-to-two matching complex with face polynomial 1+12t+48t^2+72t^3+30t^4; reproduced 78 acyclic pivot pairs, one critical vertex and five critical triangles, so each middle factor is wedge^5 S^2 while outer factors are wedge^3 S^0. The join has 225 seven-spheres. Independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz calculation over all 24 coordinate permutations yielded middle character (5,-1,1,2,1), whole character (225,1,1,0,1), multiplicities (10,9,28,28,19) summing to 225. The equivariant claim is rational homology, not an equivariant wedge homeomorphism.
